body:
# Subagents, Sysadmin Mode, and PGP/SSH Prompts This is a big one! Crush can now run a team of subagents, permissions are much more flexible, and you can now do GPG and SSH auth right inside Crush! Read on for more. ## 👩🏼‍🐰‍👩🏽 Subagents At last, subagents. Crush can now spawn a little team of friendly subagents in the background, as well as check on them, send them mid-run follow-ups, stop them, or move them to a different model.

You can watch them work right in the transcript, sidebar and header. Every subagent gets its own name, too, so you always know who's doing what. And, if you refer to them by name, Crush will know which of ’em you’re talking about! ## 🚨 Sysadmin Mode Ever wish Crush could `DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;`? Now it can, with Sysadmin mode! In fact, in Sysadmin mode, Crush can run any command on your system. Be careful.

Find Sysadmin mode in the command palette (ctrl+p) or toggle through all modes with shift+tab. ## 🙅🏻‍♀️ Safe Commands Of course, Yolo Mode still blocks dangerous commands, but now which commands are dangerous is up to you. * `permissions safe` marks commands safe for yolo * `permissions block` blocks commands completely * `permissions unblock` unblocks restricted commands ```bash # Building is fine permissions safe "go build" "cargo check" # Don't touch my infra please permissions block kubectl terraform # Curl your heart out permissions unblock curl ``` ## 🗝️ PGP and SSH It’s so annoying when you’re using an AI agent and can’t enter an SSH password, activate your Yubikey and enter GPG passwords, eh? Well, with Crush, that annoyance is a thing of the past. No more compromising your security to when usin’ AI! --- There’s tons more stuff in the changelog below, too. This is one of our biggest releases, and we're _so_ grateful for your support! Verifying the artifacts First, download the [`checksums.txt` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.100.0/checksums.txt) and the [`checksums.txt.sigstore.json` file](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.100.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json) files, for example, with `wget`: ```bash wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.100.0/checksums.txt' wget 'https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/releases/download/v0.100.0/checksums.txt.sigstore.json' ``` Then, verify it using [`cosign`](https://github.com/sigstore/cosign): ```bash cosign verify-blob \ --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/\.github/workflows/(release|nightly)\.yml@' \ --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' \ --bundle 'checksums.txt.sigstore.json' \ ./checksums.txt ``` If the output is `Verified OK`, you can safely use it to verify the checksums of other artifacts you downloaded from the release using `sha256sum`: ```bash sha256sum --ignore-missing -c checksums.txt ``` Done! You artifacts are now verified!
